description.value: Fairside Inn (likely 'Farside Inn') is a regional-cuisine restaurant situated along Fairmont Frontage Road in Fairmont Hot Springs, a Columbia Valley destination well known to touring cyclists on the Kootenay route. The restaurant offers outdoor seating and takeout, making it a practical stop for riders looking to eat al fresco or grab food to go. Vegetarian options are confirmed, broadening its appeal to cyclists with varied dietary needs.
